title: CELPIP-General: Format & Why It's Canada's Test
summary: The under-3-hour, fully computer-delivered CELPIP-General — four skills in one sitting, scored on CLB 1–12 for Canadian PR and citizenship.

nodes.label: CLB 1–12
nodes.note: Level per skill; used for Canadian immigration

chunks.heading: All four skills, one sitting, on computer
chunks.body: CELPIP-General tests **Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking** and takes **under three hours in one sitting** — there's **no separate speaking appointment**; you speak into a microphone during the same test. It's **fully computer-delivered**, so you type your writing and record your speaking.
chunks.realExample: Unlike IELTS (where speaking can be a separate day with a human examiner), CELPIP does everything on the computer in one go — including recording your spoken answers into a headset.
chunks.memoryHook: One sitting, all on computer — including speaking into a mic. No separate speaking day.

chunks.heading: It's built for Canadian English
chunks.body: CELPIP uses **everyday Canadian English** and real-life tasks (writing an email, responding to a survey, giving advice). It's accepted by **IRCC for permanent residence** and by **CIC for citizenship** (the Listening & Speaking version), which is why it's popular with Canada applicants.
chunks.realExample: A writing task might be emailing a landlord about a repair, or a speaking task giving advice to a friend — practical situations rather than academic essays.
chunks.memoryHook: Everyday Canadian English + real-life tasks. Made for Canadian immigration.

chunks.heading: Scored CLB 1–12, no negative marking
chunks.body: Each skill gets a **CELPIP level from 1 to 12**, calibrated to the **Canadian Language Benchmark (CLB)** so your level maps directly to immigration points. Multiple-choice items are **computer-scored with no penalty for wrong answers**; Writing and Speaking are judged by **at least three certified raters**.
chunks.realExample: A CELPIP level of 9 in a skill corresponds to CLB 9 — which is what Express Entry rewards most heavily. Because there's no negative marking, always answer every multiple-choice question.
chunks.memoryHook: CELPIP level = CLB level (1–12). No wrong-answer penalty — never leave a blank.

chunks.heading: Results in days, valid two years
chunks.body: CELPIP results are typically available in a **few business days** (often within about a week), and scores are **valid for two years**. That fast turnaround is another reason Canada applicants choose it when a deadline is close.
chunks.realExample: If an Express Entry profile deadline is near, CELPIP's quick results can be the difference between making the round or missing it — but confirm the current turnaround before you rely on it.
chunks.memoryHook: Results in days, valid 2 years. Fast turnaround suits tight immigration deadlines.

recall.q: What four skills does CELPIP-General test, and how is it delivered?
recall.a: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking — fully computer-delivered in one sitting, with speaking recorded on the same computer.

recall.q: What is CELPIP mainly used for?
recall.a: Canadian immigration — accepted by IRCC for permanent residence and (the Listening & Speaking version) for citizenship.
Each skill gets a CELPIP level from 1 to 12, calibrated to the Canadian Language Benchmark (CLB).

recall.q: Is there a penalty for wrong multiple-choice answers on CELPIP?
recall.a: No — multiple-choice items are computer-scored with no penalty, so you should answer every question.

recall.q: How long are CELPIP scores valid?
recall.a: Two years from the date the score report is issued.
